verdict.rationale: monday.com documents several ways to run work autonomously: scheduled status updates and reports, event-triggered workflows (create_item, change_column_value, agent mentions or assignments), and goal-and-rule agents that run on monday-managed infrastructure with admin audit of their actions. The evidence is mostly marketing-level taglines, and no independent or hands-on source confirms that background runs work reliably. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the automation/recipe builder and its scheduling limits, run history or failure handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
